questions.question: A loan is to be returned in two equal annual instalments. If the rate of interest is 10% p.a., compounded yearly, and each instalment is Rs. 3,872, then the total interest charged in this instalment scheme is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest, R = 10%

Annual installment, x = Rs. 3872

Total number of installments, N = 2

**Formula used:**

P = [x/(1 + R/100)] + [x/(1 + R/100)²] +.....+ [x/(1 + R/100)ⁿ]

where,

P = Principal borrowed, x = Annual Installments, R = Rate of Interest

**Calculation:**

Since, Total number of installments is 2.

Value of 2 installments = 2 × Rs. 3872 = Rs. 7744

Now,

P = [x/(1 + R/100)] + [x/(1 + R/100)2]

⇒ P = [3872/(1 + 10/100)] + [3872/(1 + 10/100)²]

⇒ P = [3872/(11/10)] + [3872/(11/10)²]

⇒ P = [(3872 × 10)/11] + [(3872 × 100)/121]

⇒ P = 3520 + 3200 = Rs. 6720

Total interest charged = Value of 2 installments - Principal borrowed

⇒ Total interest charged = Rs. 7744 - Rs. 6720 = Rs. 1024

**∴ The total interest charged in this installment scheme is Rs. 1024.**

questions.question: The average of 14 numbers is 73.5. If two numbers 60 and 63 are replaced by 58 and 70 and one more number x is included, then the average of the numbers now increases by 1.5. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 14 numbers is 73.5

60 and 63 were replaced by 58 and 70

**Calculation:**

Sum of all terms = Average of terms × Number of terms 

Sum of 14 terms = 14 × 73.5 

Sum of 14 numbers after replacing the two-digit = 14 × 73.5 + (58 +70) – (60 +63)

Average = sum of all numbers/Total numbers

⇒ 75 = (14 × 73.5 + 128 – 123 + x)/15

⇒ 75 = (1034 + x)/15

⇒ 1125 = 1034 + x

⇒ 91 = x

**∴**** The value of x is 91**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Let x = t + 73.5

Increasing average = ((58 +70) – (60 +63) + t)/Number of terms 

⇒ 1.5 = (5 + t)/15

⇒ 22.5 = 5 + t

⇒ 17.5 = t

x = 17.5 + 73.5 = 91

∴ The value of x is 91

questions.question: The income of A is 60% more than the income of B, and the income of C is 45% less than the income of A and B. By what percentage is C's income less than that of income of A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The income of A = 60% more than the income of B.

The income of C = 45% less than the income of (A + B).

**Formula used:**

Percentage = {(Final value - Initial value)/Initial value} × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the income of B be 100.

So, income of A = 100 + (100 × 60/100) = 160

Income of A + B = 100 + 160 = 260

And, income of C = 260 - (260 × 45/100)

⇒ Income of C = 260 - 117 = 143

Required percentage difference = {(160 - 143)/160} × 100

⇒ 170/16 = 10.625%

**∴ C's income is 10.625% less than that of income of A.**

A ∶ B ∶ C = 160 ∶ 100 ∶ 143

Required percentage = [(160 - 143)/160] × 100 = 170/16 = 10.625%

**∴ C's income is 10.625% less than that of incoe of A**

questions.question: A certain number of students from school A appeared in an examination and 65% of them passed. 100% more students than those in school A, appeared in the same examination from school B. If 75% of the total students who appeared from schools A and B passed, then what is the percentage of students who failed from school B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of passing students in school A = 65%

Percentage of passing students in schools A and B = 75%

Compared to school B 100% more students appeared in school A.

**Calculation: **

Let the number of students in school A is Y and the number of passing student in school B is P%

Percentage of passing students in school A = Y × 65%

Percentage of passing student in school A = Y × (65/100)

Total number of students in school B = 2Y

Percentage of passing students in school B = 2Y × P%

Percentage of the total number of passing students in schools A and B = (Y + 2Y) × 75%

⇒ Y × 65% + 2Y × P% = (Y+ 2Y) × 75%

⇒ Y × (65/100) + 2Y × (P/100) = (3Y) × (75/100)

⇒ 2Y × (P/100) = (225Y/100) – (65Y/100)

⇒ 2Y × (P/100) = (160Y/100)

⇒ 2Y × (P/100) = (160Y/100)

⇒ (P/100) = (80/100)

⇒ P = 80

Percentage of failed student in school B = 100% – 80%

Percentage of failed students in school B = 20%

**∴**** The percentage of failed students in school B is 20%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

Let the Total number of student in school A is 100 and the failed student in school B is Q%

Percentage of Failed students in school A = 100 × 35%

Percentage of Failed student in school A = 100 × (35/100)

Percentage of Failed student in school A = 35

100% more students than those in school A, appeared in the same examination from school B.

⇒ Total number of student in school B = 100 × (200/100)

⇒ Total number of students in school B = 200

⇒ Total number of students in schools A and B = (100 + 200)

⇒ Total number of students in schools A and B = 300

Total number of students who failed in schools A and B = 300 × 25%

⇒ 100 × 35% + 200 × Q% = 300 × 25%

⇒ 100 × (35/100) + 200 × (Q/100) = 300 × (25/100)

⇒ 35 + 2 × Q = 75

⇒ 2Q = 40

⇒ Q = 20

**∴ The percentage of students who failed in school B is 20%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let total students in school A be 100

Apassed = 65% of 100 = 65

Btotal = 200% of 100 = 200

(A + B)passed = 75% of (A + B)total = 75% of 300 = 225

Bpassed = 225 - 65 = 160

Bfailed = [(200 -160)/200] × 100 = 20%

questions.question: The rate of interest on a sum for the first 3 years is 8% p.a., for the next 4 years it is 10% p.a., and for the period beyond 7 years, it is 16% p.a. If a person gets Rs. 11,340 simple interest after 10 years, how much money did he invest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The rate of interest on a sum for the first 3 years is 8% p.a.

For the next 4 years, it is 10% p.a.

For the period beyond 7 years, it is 16% p.a.

A person gets Rs. 11340 simple interest after 10 years.

**Concept used:**

For simple interest, the rate of interest will always be the same every year.

The principal will always be considered as 100%

**Formula used:**

S.I = PRT/100

Where S.I is Simple interest, P is Principal, T is time period

**Calculation:**

The overall rate of interest for the first 3 years at 8% = (3 × 8)% = 24%

The overall rate of interest for the next 4 years at 10% = (4 × 10)% = 40%

Now, according to the question the person invested his principal for 10 years.

So, for the remaining 3 years, the rate of interest will be 16% per annum.

Then, his rate of interest for 3 years will be (16 × 3)% = 48%

Total interest will be received for 10 years is (24% + 40% + 48%) = 112% of the principal.

So, 112% = 11340

⇒ 100% = 11340/112 × 100

⇒ 10125

**∴**** He invested Rs. 10125 for 10 years.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** SI = PRT/100

11340 = P × [(8% × 3) + (10% × 4) + (16% × 3)]

⇒ 11340 × 100 = P × 112

⇒ P = Rs. 10125

questions.question: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder is 1320 cm² and the radius of its base is 10.5 cm. The volume (in cm³) of the cylinder is: (Take pi = frac{{22}}{7})
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The curved surface area of right circular cylinder is 1320 cm² 

Radius of the base is 10.5 cm

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

Where r = radius, h = height

**Calculations:**

Curved surface area of cylinder is 2πrh

⇒ 2πrh = 1320

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 10.5 × h = 1320

⇒ h = (1320 × 7)/(2 × 22 × 10.5) = 20 cm

Height of the cylinder = 20 cm

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 240. It is sold by giving a discount of 10% on the marked price. If the profit is 8%, then what is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price of the article, MP = Rs. 240

Discount% = 10, Profit% = 8

**Formula Used:**

Discount% = {(MP – SP)/MP} × 100

Profit% = {(SP – CP)/CP} × 100 

where, MP = Marked Price, SP = Selling Price and CP = Cost Price

**Calculation:**

Here, Discount% = {(MP – SP)/MP} × 100

⇒ 10 = {(240 – SP)/240} × 100

⇒ 10/100 × 240 = 240 – SP

⇒ 24 = 240 – SP

⇒ SP = 240 – 24 = 216

Now, Profit% = {(SP – CP)/CP} × 100

⇒ 8 = {(216 – CP)/CP} × 100

⇒ (8/100) × CP = 216 – CP

⇒ CP + (8/100) × CP = 216

⇒ (108/100) × CP = 216

⇒ CP = 216 × 100/108 = 200

**∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Here, MP = 240, and discount is 10%

So, SP = 90% of 240

⇒ SP = 90/100 × 240 = 216

Now, Profit is 8%

So, SP/CP = 108/100

⇒ CP = 216 × 100/108 = 200

**∴**** The cost price of the article is Rs. 200**

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 10 days and 15 days, respectively. They work together for 4 days. The remaining work is completed by C alone in 12 days. C alone will complete (4)/(9) part of the original work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the work is 10 days.

Time taken by B to complete the work is 15 days.

Time taken by C to complete remaining work is 12 days.

**Concept Used:**

Time taken = (Total work done)/(Efficiency)

**Calculation:**

Let the work done by A, B and C be in Units.

Total Work done by (A + B) = L.C.M of (10, 15) 

⇒ 30 Units

Now,

Efficiency of A = Total Work/Time taken

⇒ 30/10 = 3 units per day

Efficiency of B = Total Work/Time taken

⇒ 30/15 = 2 units per day

Total Work done by (A + B) in 4 days = (Sum of efficiency of A and B) × 4

⇒ (3 + 2) × 4 = 20 units

Remaining Work = (30 - 20) = 10 units

Efficiency of C for completing remaining work = 10/12

⇒ (5/6) unit per day

Then,

Time taken by C to complete (4/9) part of original work = 30 × (4/9) × (6/5)

⇒ 16 days

**∴ Time taken by C to complete (4/9) part of original work is 16 days**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

questions.question: Roshan bought 36 kg sugar for Rs. 1,620. He sold it at a profit equal to the selling price of 6 kg of it. Then what is the selling price of per kg sugar?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

C.P. of 36 kg sugar = 1620

Profit = S.P. of 6 kg sugar

C.P. = Cost price, S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

Here Quantity of sold sugar = Quantity of sugar bought - profitable sugar

⇒ Quantity of sold sugar = (36 - 6) kg

⇒ Quantity of sold sugar = 30 kg

So after selling 30 kg of sugar we get C.P. of 36 kg

So, 36 × C.P. = 30 × S.P.

⇒ Rs. 1620 = 30 × S.P.

⇒ S.P. = Rs. 1620/30 = Rs. 54

**∴ Roshan's selling price per kg is Rs. 54.**

questions.question: In a division sum, the divisor is 18 times the quotient and 9 times the remainder. If the remainder is 26, then the dividend is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisor is 18 times of quotient and 9 times the remainder

Remainder is 26

**Formula used:**

Dividend = Divisor(D) × Quotient(Q) + Remainder

**Calculation:**

If D = 18Q, R = 26

Dividend = Divisor(D) × Quotient(Q) + Remainder

⇒ 18Q × Q + 26 ----(1)

If D = 9 × 26, R = 26 

Dividend = Divisor(D) × Quotient(Q) + Remainder

⇒ 9 × 26 × Q + 26 ----(2)

Compare equation (1) and (2)

⇒ 18Q × Q + 26 = 9 × 26 × Q + 26 

⇒ 18Q² = 9 × 26 × Q

⇒ Q = 13

Put the value of Q in equation (2)

Dividend = 9 × 26 × 13 + 26

⇒ 26(117 + 1)

⇒ 3068

**∴**** The dividend is 3068**

questions.question: The perimeter of a rhombus is 148 cm and one of its diagonals is 70 cm. Its area is equal to the area of a rectangle whose sides are in ratio 7 ∶ 3. The longer side of the rectangle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of a rhombus = 148 cm

One diagonal = 70 cm

The ratio of sides of rectangle = 7 : 3

**Concept used:**

The diagonals of a rhombus are intersected each other at right angle.

**Formula Used: **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63b88f0fb1b3709729e98276a2f51ea827e17a73f50ef183eeec55168afb6995.png] **

Area of Rhombus = 1/2 × d₁ × d₂

where,

d₁, d₂ are diagonals of the rhombus.

**Calculation:**

In right-angle triangle ΔAOB,

⇒ AB² = AO² + OB²

⇒ (37)² = (35)² + OB²

⇒ OB² =1369 - 1225 = 144

⇒ OB = 12

AC = 2 × OB =2 × 12 = 24 cm

Area of rhombus = 1/2 × 24 × 70 = 840

Now, Area of rhombus = Area of rectangle

Let the side of rectangle be 7x and 3x respectively.

⇒ 7x × 3x = 840

⇒ x² = 40

⇒ x = 2√10

Longer side of rectangle = 7x = 7 × 2√10 = 14√10

**∴ Longer side of rectangle is 14√10 cm.**
